answer: Sensor-vertex identity: each agent binds to one physical mesh vertex — a $40 soil sensor in a yarrow meadow — and must stream one fresh signed reading, its pearl, every epoch. One fake costs $40 of hardware plus $6/month uplink, and 1,000 fakes need 1,000 separate sensors, because a reading is stamped to one place and one minute. Peers re-query a random sensor's public feed and compare: a pearl that doesn't match the live yarrow pollen count fails — the identity is revoked and its bond burned.
